action: "Carve a big opening for his mouth": a wide recess is pushed into the lower face (00:03).
why: The huge open mouth is the character's main read.

action: "Then pull up the corners" of the mouth so it curls up into the cheeks (hooked corner visible at 00:08).
"Carve the corners of his eyes" (stroke on the brow at 00:04).
"Add a new sphere for his first tooth", pulled into a fang (selected yellow tooth at 00:15).
why: One master tooth that will be copied.

action: "Mirror it, duplicate it, place it, duplicate it again, place it again, then do it one more time" to make the upper fang row (00:15-00:17).
why: Teeth are copies of one sculpted fang, mirrored across the centre.

action: "Duplicate his upper teeth for his lower ones" and flip them into the lower jaw.
why: Lower row from the finished upper row.

action: "Add a sphere for his tongue, pull it out, smooth it" (orange sphere in the mouth at 00:23, long tongue at 00:25).
tool: Add UV Sphere + Snake Hook/Grab + Smooth
why: Tongue is a separate part pulled out of a sphere.

action: "Curve it to make it more dynamic": the tongue tip is swept sideways into an S (Grab ring on it at 00:27).
why: A curve adds motion to a static bust.

action: "Make his eyes narrower and scarier, giving him that venom look" (brow ridges worked close-up 00:29-00:33).
why: The narrow angled eye shape is the likeness cue.

action: "Duplicate his tongue, make it smaller, paint it white, and use that as a base to create saliva coming out of his mouth" (thin yellow-selected strand at 00:58, white strand at 01:03).
why: Saliva strands from an existing tube shape; adds motion.

action: "Add it for his tongue, a few for the bottom part of his mouth, add some on the side of his mouth" (strands 01:05-01:07).
"Continue to refine the different parts you already sculpted until you're satisfied" (head close-ups 01:09-01:11).
"Add one more sphere, sculpt it around his upper jaw, then paint it dark red to represent his gum" (Shift+A search shows Mesh > UV Sphere at 01:13; gum shaped around teeth at 01:15).
tool: Add > Mesh > UV Sphere, Grab, Paint brush
why: Gum as its own part that hides the tooth roots.

action: "Duplicate it for his lower jaw, and go over your sculpt one more time to refine it" (01:17-01:23).
why: Lower gum from upper gum; final pass.
